an4.159:2.1: “Sir, the nun named so-and-so is sick, suffering, and gravely ill.
an4.159:2.2: She bows with her head to your feet, and says:
an4.159:2.3: ‘Sir, please go to the nuns’ quarters to visit that nun out of sympathy.’”
